info.title: CF Meet Messaging API
info.description: HTTP surface of services/messaging: GET /health, /ready, /openapi.json (public, no data); the customer API under /v1/messaging and /v1/conversations (CF Meet API credential verified by Platform Access — afresh for every mutation; a verified acting principal; 503 when Platform Access is unreachable — fail closed; client tokens are accepted only on the member operations whose security lists clientToken (elsewhere 401 CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED); the device-direct realtime routes /v1/realtime/tickets (client token) and /v1/realtime (WebSocket, single-use ticket) authenticate themselves). /internal/v1/** is service-authenticated and exposes no operation yet. Request bodies are limited to 512 KiB. 1.13.0: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}/thread (thread summary); pin expiry; conversation retentionSeconds / expiryGraceSeconds. Member roles, invitations (POST .../invitation/accept|decline, GET /v1/messaging/invitations).

post.description: Scope conversations.create; the acting principal becomes the owner. Context class and security profile are checked against the persisted effective policy: the profile defaults to the context's default (PRIVATE_E2EE where eligible), MANAGED only where the application policy allows it, never a silent fallback (E2EE_NOT_AVAILABLE when encryption cannot be established). DIRECT conversations are deduplicated per principal pair and profile; a live context reference is unique. Idempotency-Key replays the stored response (200).

delete.description: Leaving (acting = the member): messages.send. Removing another member: conversations.manage (+ OWNER / ADMIN). PRIVATE_E2EE: the member's devices become pending MLS removals; the group accepts only a removal commit until one is accepted (mlsRekeyRequired). On an INVITED principal this revokes the invitation (or, by the invitee itself, declines it) and returns the Member view (state REMOVED / LEFT). A MODERATOR may remove MEMBER / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE members.

post.description: Scope messages.send. An upload intent (signed PUT of exactly size bytes with that SHA-256) for the acting principal's own ACTIVE device; at most 3 unfinished intents; size ≤ backups.maxBytes (413 BACKUP_TOO_LARGE). Opt-in secure backups (Appendix I.3): the object is encrypted on the client with the shared crypto core under a root key only the user holds; the server never receives a key, a recovery code or content and cannot decrypt the object. Only the acting principal's own backups; another principal's are NOT_FOUND. Refused while backups.enabled is false (503 FEATURE_DISABLED BACKUPS_DISABLED) or the BACKUPS kill switch is engaged.

clientToken.description: CF-Client-Token <Messaging Client Access Token> (device-direct, §105). Accepted by POST /v1/realtime/tickets and, as an alternative to customerCredential, by the member operations that list it: the token's session (device ACTIVE, session ACTIVE and unexpired, principal ACTIVE) is the caller, acting only for its own principal and own device (CF-Acting-Principal may only repeat it). Every other operation answers 401 CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED.
